scope: Only the before control replaces the idle production stream. The after arm retains and observes the exact inherited kit stream and aliases. Route, commands, focus override, authority, snapshot, close and profile guards remain inherited from the approved fixture. Output names are separate and all outputs/roaming/summary must be fresh. Production-seam acceptance additionally requires zero later route callbacks with area loading before or after the inherited process; raw rows and a receipt count retain this check.
